spans.s:
खद् खद्, cl. 1. P. खदति, चखाद,
अखदीत् and अखादीत्, &c., to be steady
or firm, to strike, hurt, kill; to eat (?); [cf. Lat.
clades.]

खाद् खाद्, cl. 1. P. (ep. also A.) खादति,
चखाद, खादिष्यति, अखादीत्, खा-
दितुम्, to chew, bite, eat, devour, feed, prey upon;
to hurt: Caus. खादयति, -यितुम्, to cause or make
to eat or devour; to eat: Desid. चिखादिषति:
Intens. चाखाद्यते, चाखात्ति; [cf. Scot. cuid,
‘food;’ Hib. caithim, ‘to eat.’]

खदिर, अस्, m. the tree Acacia Catechu, having
very hard wood, the resin of which is used in medi-
cine, called Catechu, Khayar, Terra Japonica; an
epithet of Indra; the moon; N. of a man; (ई), f.
a sensitive plant, Mimosa Pudica; (sometimes also
[]
खदिरा.)
—खदिर-कुण, अस्, m. the fruit time
of the Khadira tree.
—खदिर-पत्त्रिका or ख-
दिर-पत्त्री, f. a sensitive plant, a kind of Mimosa
(खदिरी).
—खदिर-मय, अस्, ई, अम्, made of
the wood of Khadira.
—खदिर-वण, अम्, n. a
Khadira forest.
—खदिर-वणिक, अस्, m., N. of a
Buddhist Bhikṣu.
—खदिर-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्,
overgrown with Khadira; (ती), f., N. of a region.
—खदिर-वर्मन्, आ, m., N. of a king.
—ख-
दिर-स्वामिन्, ई, m., N. of a scholiast.
—खदिरो-
पम (˚र-उप्˚), अम्, n. a kind of Mimosa (क-
दर).

खादिर खादिर, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. खदिर),
made of or coming from the tree Acacia Catechu;
(अस्), m. Catechu extract prepared from the tree
Acacia Catechu.
—खादिर-गृह्य, अम्, n., N. of a
literary work.
—खादिर-सार, अस्, m. Catechu, the
resinous extract of the tree Acacia Catechu.
खदिरक, अस्, m., N. of a mountain.

खदिका खदिका, आस्, f. pl. fried or parched
grain.

खदूरक खदूरक, अस्, m., N. of a man;
(अम्), n. a dwarf.

खदूरवासिनी ख-दूर-वासिनी, &c. See
under 3. ख.

खाद, अस्, आ, अम्, eating, devouring, (at the end
of compounds, e. g. अमित्र-खाद, वृत्र-खाद,
q. v.); (अस्), m. chewing, eating; food.

खादक, अस्, इका, अम्, eating, consuming, de-
vouring; an eater; a debtor; a borrower, one who
borrows or uses; [cf. खातक.]

खादत-मोदता, f. (fr. the two impv. खादत
and मोदत), continual eating and being glad.
—खादत-वामता, f. (fr. the two impv. खादत
and वामत), continual eating and vomiting.
—खा-
दता-चमता or खादता-चामता, f. continual eat-
ing and washing the mouth.
खादनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, eatable, edible, to be eaten.

खादित, अस्, आ, अम्, eaten, devoured.
—खादित-
वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, having eaten, eating, feeding.

खादितव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be eaten, what may
be or must be eaten.

1. खादिन्, ई, इनी, इ, eating. (For 2. see under
खादि.)

2. खादिन्, ई, इनी, इ, Ved. decorated with bracelets
or rings (as the Maruts).

खादुक, अस्, ई, अम्, mischievous, injurious, ma-
lignant.

खाद्य, अस्, आ, अम्, eatable, edible, what may or
must be eaten; (अम्), n. food, victuals.
—खाद्या-
खाध्य (˚य-अख्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, fit or unfit for food.

खादि खादि, इस्, m., Ved. a brooch, brace-
let, ring (worn on the hands or feet especially by the
Maruts).
—खादि-हस्त, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. having the
hands ornamented with bracelets or rings, epithet of
the Maruts.

खादोअर्णस् खादोअर्णस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, Ved.
tearing away the bank (as a river ?).
